description: Procedural violation by prosecution with clear legal remedy

input.problem_statement: Client's rights violated - police interrogated for 6 hours without breaks, lawyer denied access for 2 hours after request. Confession obtained. Clear ZKP violations.

legal_arguments.title: Confession obtained through rights violations
legal_arguments.argument: Multiple procedural violations (excessive interrogation, denial of counsel) mandate exclusion
legal_basis: Constitutional Court precedent on interrogation limits
potential_counterarguments: Prosecution may claim confession was voluntary despite violations

procedural_steps: If granted and no other evidence, move to dismiss

validation_notes: Should score 15-40 (low risk) due to clear multiple rights violations (6hr interrogation + counsel denial), binding Constitutional Court + Supreme Court precedents mandating exclusion, strong legal basis, no viable prosecution defenses.
